title: Apocalypse Clock: Global Systemic Risk Monitor
description: Apocalypse Clock is an experimental, browser-based systemic-risk dashboard for exploring interacting global threats through scenario controls, Monte Carlo uncertainty sampling, dependency-aware aggregation, Weibull horizon diagnostics, network analysis, and exportable model outputs. The project is not peer reviewed. Model outputs are scenario outputs, not predictions.
notes: Version 1.2.8 introduces dataset v1.9.0 and the directed functional-cascade model, with explicit dependency lags, critical-function weights, essential-service baskets, overlap-aware aggregation, revised exports, validation checks, and expanded methodology and limitation documentation. It does not claim empirical calibration or predictive validation. Released under the custom source-available non-commercial fork license; the project is not peer reviewed and outputs remain conditional scenarios, not predictions.
